'''Ben Quadinaros' Podracer''' was a [[Balta-Trabaat/Legends|Balta-Trabaat]] [[BT310 Quadra/Legends|BT310 Quadra]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] owned and operated by [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]. The vehicle incorporated four [[Engine/Legends|engines]] rather than the traditional two. This configuration gave Quadinaros' Podracer the potential to be the fastest, although it also suffered from inconsistent performance.<ref name="CCG-BenPodracer" />
